name: ContentByUri
query: fragment ContentFields on ContentNode { __typename databaseId status uri ... on NodeWithContentEditor { content } ... on NodeWithTitle { title } ... on Page { ...PageBuilderFields } ... on Post { author { node { name } } date } ... on WithAcfHero { hero { cta { target title url } eyebrow headline intro } } } fragment PageBuilderFields on WithAcfPageBuilder { pageBuilder { sections { __typename ... on PageBuilderSectionsBlockquoteLayout { attribution image { ...PageBuilderImage } quote role sectionOptions { ...PageBuilderSectionOptions } } ... on PageBuilderSectionsCallToActionLayout { body heading links { ...PageBuilderLinks } sectionOptions { ...PageBuilderSectionOptions } } ... on PageBuilderSectionsCardGridLayout { cards { image { ...PageBuilderImage } link { ...PageBuilderLink } text title } columns heading sectionOptions { ...PageBuilderSectionOptions } } ... on PageBuilderSectionsContentLayout { align body eyebrow heading links { ...PageBuilderLinks } sectionOptions { ...PageBuilderSectionOptions } } ... on PageBuilderSectionsContentMediaLayout { body eyebrow heading links { ...PageBuilderLinks } media { ...PageBuilderImage } mediaPosition sectionOptions { ...PageBuilderSectionOptions } } ... on PageBuilderSectionsMediaLayout { media { ...PageBuilderImage } sectionOptions { ...PageBuilderSectionOptions } } } } } fragment PageBuilderImage on AcfMediaItemConnectionEdge { node { altText caption mediaDetails { height width } sourceUrl } } fragment PageBuilderLink on AcfLink { target title url } fragment PageBuilderLinks on PageBuilderSectionsLinks { link { ...PageBuilderLink } variant } fragment PageBuilderSectionOptions on PageBuilderSectionsSectionOptions { anchor hidden paddingBottom paddingTop skin width } query ContentByUri($uri: String!) { nodeByUri(uri: $uri) { ... on ContentNode { ...ContentFields } } }

name: Layout
query: query Layout { generalSettings { description title } menuItems(where: { location: PRIMARY }, first: 20) { nodes { id label target uri } } }

name: PreviewContent
